1.e4 c5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.d3 g6 4.g4.strategy: Gains kingside space at once, with g5 to follow so that Black's king's knight loses f6. It is double-edged: Black can attack the pawn straight away with ...h5, and every pawn push loosens White's own king's side before the pieces are developed.
1.e4 c5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.d3 g6 4.g4.name: Sicilian Defence: Closed, Portland Attack
